_meta.privacy: allowlist: only these columns are written; no coordinates, names, interviewer codes or free text

forbidden_columns: _พิกัดครัวเรือน (ปักหมุด)_latitude
_พิกัดครัวเรือน (ปักหมุด)_longitude

columns.name: household_code
columns.description: pseudonymous household id from the export (HMAC), never the real id

columns.name: heat_risk
columns.description: group 1 heat impact 0-1: mean of C2.1, C2.5 symptoms, D1.1, D2.1, D2.2, A13 (higher = riskier)

columns.name: housing_risk
columns.description: group 2 housing 0-1: mean of the answered items of B4, B6, B7, B8, B9 (at least 4)

columns.name: finance_risk
columns.description: group 3 financial stability 0-1: mean of the answered items of A6, A11, A10, A8 above A7 (at least 3)

columns.name: burden_risk
columns.description: group 4 energy burden 0-1: geometric middle of the burden range divided by the 20% cap, at most 1

columns.name: coping_risk
columns.description: group 5 coping 0-1: mean of the answered items of A14, B12, G8 (at least 2)

columns.name: burden_min
columns.description: T07 summer bill_min / income_max

columns.name: burden_max
columns.description: T07 summer bill_max / income_min

columns.name: exposure
columns.description: axis 0-1: mean of heat_risk and housing_risk

columns.name: vulnerability
columns.description: axis 0-1: mean of finance_risk, burden_risk and coping_risk

columns.name: risk_score
columns.description: 0-100: 100 x the mean of the five groups; null when any group is null

columns.name: risk_rank
columns.description: 1 = riskiest; equal scores share a rank; null when risk_score is null

columns.name: risk_quadrant
columns.description: help_first / watch / low_heat_limited / low_heat_coping: exposure and vulnerability each cut at 0.5

columns.name: lst_mean_c
columns.description: community LST (deg C) from curated/community_dim for the household's community_key; null when the community is unknown or has no LST

columns.name: lst_score
columns.description: lst_mean_c on the fixed 30-45 deg C range -> 0-1; a separate indicator, NOT part of risk_score (D21)

columns.name: lst_batch_id
columns.description: gee_lst batch the LST came from (lineage); null when no LST was joined

columns.name: lst_hh_c
columns.description: household LST (deg C) from curated/household_lst (50 m around the household point); null when the household has no usable coordinates or no clear pixel

columns.name: lst_hh_score
columns.description: lst_hh_c on the fixed 30-45 deg C range -> 0-1; a separate indicator, NOT part of risk_score (D21)

columns.name: lst_hh_batch_id
columns.description: gee_lst_household batch the LST came from (lineage); null when no LST was joined

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: T12 lineage: ingest batch id

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: T12 lineage: row number in the raw sheet
